description: Sends a contact a test alert, at most 5 a minute for a workspace. For a phone contact it is a real text or call through the user's account, which counts toward its 6 texts or 3 calls an hour; an error says in words what the provider refused (credentials, a trial account's unverified number, the sender).

id.description: Contact ID from add_notification_contact or list_notification_contacts.
